description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget named `CodegenScreen` which provides a user interface for a code generation feature. It includes input fields for selecting programming language, a description of the desired code, optional document reference, and a generate button. It also displays generated code with options to copy or share. The file manages state, interacts with a provider (`CodegenProvider`) for logic, and builds a responsive UI with various custom widgets.
